description: This file declares the JWTSecApi class, which provides an interface for JWT token encoding, decoding, and signature validation, along with internal classes for cryptographic key management and MAC generation.

classes.name: JWTSecApi
classes.description: Main class providing JWT token operations including encoding, decoding, and signature validation.

classes.name: JWTSecApi::SecApi
classes.description: Internal class managing cryptographic key generation, deletion, and MAC operations.

classes.name: JWTSecApi::MacGenerator
classes.description: Internal class responsible for generating Message Authentication Codes (MACs) using stored keys.

methods.name: Encode
methods.description: Encodes a payload into a JWT token.

methods.name: Decode
methods.description: Decodes a JWT token into its payload.

methods.name: PayloadLength
methods.description: Returns the length of the payload in a JWT token.

methods.name: ValidSignature
methods.description: Validates the signature of a JWT token.
